configuration.server: letta server 0.16.8, PostgreSQL 18.1 + pgvector 0.8.5, init.sql + alembic head 1c28e167b74f, no Redis
configuration.isolation: fresh agent (own archive) per question; agent and its archive deleted afterwards (bridge 0.1.1-candidate; retrieval path unchanged from 0.1.0)
configuration.insert: POST /v1/agents/{id}/archival-memory, one call per document (one passage each)
configuration.llm: none invoked (llm_config points at a closed loopback port)

notes: CPU (4 vCPU) shared with the concurrent MemPalace repeat for most of the run; latencies are indicative only, not comparative performance measurements.
Dependencies resolved with uv --exclude-newer 2026-05-15 (release date); unbounded resolution produced an mcp/pydantic import incompatibility.
Executed in segments: container reclamation while the session was idle ended several driver invocations; each resumed from the committed rows (input sha and question ids checked on resume).
limitations: Retrieval only on the frozen LongMemEval-S evaluator; not LongMemEval QA or LoCoMo QA.
Measures Letta's archival-memory retrieval API, not Letta's end-to-end self-editing stateful agent.
Embedder (fastembed bge-small-en-v1.5) is this evaluator's local choice; Letta's defaults are hosted embedders.
Candidate: requires independent adapter/protocol review before acceptance.
